root_cause.text: In snd_pcm_drain(), the code accesses fields of a linked stream's runtime (no_period_wakeup, rate, buffer_size) after releasing the stream lock, without any synchronization, allowing a concurrent close() on the linked stream to kfree() that runtime and cause a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains that after reassigning `runtime` to a linked stream's runtime and releasing the stream lock (line 2169), the code at lines 2170-2178 dereferences `runtime->no_period_wakeup`, `runtime->rate`, and `runtime->buffer_size` without protection. The patch caches these fields into local variables before releasing the lock to prevent the race.
